_note: Koeppen-Geiger zones are STRINGS in gscad's static.csv ('C', 'Cfb') but NUMERIC
codes in the prepared hourly_q_dl batches. The code is the alphabetical index
over the values present in THAT dataset -- recovered empirically by matching 700
prepared batches against hourly/dataframes/static.csv, and confirmed to be
one-to-one and to reproduce every observed pair.
Because the index depends on which values the dataset happens to contain, the
training vocabulary below is NOT the full Koeppen list. The daily database holds
eight further values with no code in it: As, Cwb, Cwc, Dfd, Dsd, Dwc, Dwd, Ocean.
40 of the 294 African basins (13.6%) are Cwb or Cwc, so they cannot be encoded
Zones present in African basins but absent from the training vocabulary.
Cwb and Cwc are mapped to Cwa: all three are C (temperate) with a dry winter,
differing only in summer warmth, so the substitution keeps both the major class
and the dry-winter attribute. It affects 40 of 294 basins and must be reported
